acceptance: Generic application validation requires independently observed and validated selected-app contact and scoped application-description evidence. Application identity, operation, discovery provenance and returned contacts agree; contract self-assertion alone cannot establish the binding.

Registration request construction copies the exact validated discovered URI, method and context-header declaration. Current v1 schemas, safe URI and trusted-origin checks remain enforced; mismatched applications, altered contacts, unsafe paths, authority selectors and unsupported versions fail closed.

Discovery refresh, contract-facts projection and callback-source readiness preserve the selected application binding and literal observed declarations without mutating source documents or turning descriptive scope labels into authorization evidence.

Commercial admission handling requires a matching declaration in the actual validated operation descriptor and the canonical correlated error envelope. Only HTTP 403 PAID_PLAN_REQUIRED with retryable false and HTTP 503 MCP_ENTITLEMENT_UNAVAILABLE with retryable true receive their respective dispositions; undeclared, mismatched, malformed and obsolete HTTP 402 variants fail closed.

Payment prerequisites and temporary entitlement failures preserve canonical error content without authentication recovery, automatic payment, invented retry timing or uncertain registration replay. Existing compile/start, returned-action, callback and bounded recovery behavior remains intact.

Legacy application helper calls and existing current-v1 discovery and registration contracts remain compatible. Native BOSL execution exceptions retain their existing application allowlist; generic application discovery creates no new native execution alias or host capability.

Canonical guidance and generated consumers remain equivalent. Required skill versions and exact dependency pins advance consistently, package metadata remains valid, and runtime helpers remain usable in generated distributions.

Individual-record lookup retains graph completion after clarification, complete intermediate routes, compact preferred presentation, truthful partial evidence, ranking provenance and explicit format choices. Native visualization takes priority, labels remain plain text, and the focused student-workflow exception remains scoped.

acceptance_tests.purpose: Verify independent application-contact selection, refusal boundaries and legacy contact compatibility.
Verify selected-app description and resource binding, refresh propagation, mismatches and existing discovery behavior.
Verify exact current-v1 registration contacts, complete schemas, advertised commercial error declarations and refusal cases.
Reproduce application-bound request and commercial-admission failures, then verify exact construction, descriptor-bound interpretation and conservative lifecycle recovery.
Verify selected-app contract projection preserves provenance and literal declarations without granting authority.
Verify readiness consumption preserves discovered binding, original registration custody and supported failure handling.
Verify existing trusted transport, scope continuity, non-authentication error handling and replay boundaries remain intact.
Verify generated runtime helpers, framing, context handling and lifecycle guidance preserve canonical behavior.
Verify skill version advancement, exact dependency pins and source identities.
Verify generated package composition, dependency closure, guidance transformations and metadata.
Verify generated package parity and existing host-owned connection boundaries.
Preserve canonical and generated graph handoffs, compact response completeness, plain labels, rendering selection and the focused student exception.

selection.reason: Application binding and registration error handling cross discovery, request construction, projection, readiness and generated consumers. Capture complete assertion failures against unchanged implementation and preserve the focused test bytes for passing execution after correction. Behavioral changes are limited to the four named runtime files and four named guidance files; other canonical skill changes are limited to required versions and exact dependency pins. Keep adapter, authority, connection, cache and returned-action implementations unchanged. Preserve original contracts and evidence, the original delivery clock, existing privacy and publication gates, and the 300-second end-to-end budget. Use the general native runtime review and exact-source publication route without altering bounded deterministic profiles. Synthetic checks establish source compatibility only; live service and published-client acceptance require separate evidence.
